pages.title: Megalonyx
pages.text: The Megalonyx ($(o)Megalonyx jeffersonii$()), or Jefferson's ground sloth, is an extinct ground sloth that lived across North America during the Pleistocene, ranging as far north as Alaska and the Yukon.$(br2)Its fossils were described by Thomas Jefferson in 1797, and the species was later named in his honour.$(br2)Megalonyx, meaning "giant claw", was a browser roughly three metres long, with large claws on its forelimbs.
